# prismasdwan_syslog_profile (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Syslog Profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "syslog_profile".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_syslog_profile" "example" {
  name           = "example_name"
  protocol       = "udp"
  server_ip      = "10.0.0.1"
  server_port    = 443
  severity_level = "major"
  tags           = ["terraform"]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Value: at most 256 characters. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `enable_dns_logging` (Boolean) Enable dns logging. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `enable_flow_logging` (Boolean) Enable flow logging. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `enable_threat_logging` (Boolean) Enable threat logging. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `enable_url_logging` (Boolean) Enable url logging. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object, assigned by the API. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `name` (String) Name. Value: at most 128 characters.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol. Value: one of tcp, udp, tls.
- `remote_ca_certificate` (String) Remote ca certificate. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `server_fqdn` (String) Server fqdn. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `server_ip` (String) Server ip.
- `server_port` (Number) Server port. Value: between 1 and 65535.
- `severity_level` (String) Severity level. Value: one of major, minor, critical.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. At most 10 items. Each item: at most 128 characters, matching `[^,\s]+`.
- `x_etag` (Number) Etag for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.
- `x_parameters` (Map of String) Path parameters for the resource, managed automatically by the provider.
- `x_schema` (Number) Schema version for this object. Value: at least 1. Filled in by the server when it is not set.

### Read-Only

- `tfid` (String) The Terraform internal identifier for this resource.
